ModMetaData.name: RimScent Extended: Perfume Plus Expansion
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Everything a colonist wears, drinks or breathes that leaves a trace on them.
RimScent's Perfume Expansion gives you five perfumes. This translates it into French — it ships no Languages folder at all — and wires up three more mods that built entire perfume lines without ever declaring a single scent.
MOD PERFUMES (Romyashi) Five worn perfumes, plus aromaflower petals. The mod has a full perfumery — bottles, a still, a research project — and not one ModExtension_Scent anywhere in it. Each perfume now smells of what it is made from: flowers, cut greenery, the hunting blend that hides you, the ancient one recovered from ruins, and the anima perfume.
The anima perfume comes from a separate module and carries a MayRequire on it. Its patch is wrapped in a nested conditional, and its translation lives in its own folder gated on the same mod — a translation key aimed at an absent def is a load error, not a warning.
SOCIAL SUPPLEMENTS - The three worn "Scenters" — the same worn-scent thought the perfumes use. - Two vapes. The scent lasts exactly as long as the high does, the way vanilla smokeleaf already works. - Mouthwash, mint tea, the mint plant and its leaves: mint. - Chilli peppers and hot sauce: pepper in the air, mildly unpleasant. - Polyflower, its petals and its juice reuse RimScent's own flowery scent. The plant does not carry purpose="Beauty" — checked — so the base flower patch never caught it.
Worn scents come from the hediff, not the item, which is the one thing RimScent reads on a neighbouring pawn. That is why they work at all.
Ships in English with a French translation injected on top, so it works in any language. Each mod's support loads only when that mod is active. No save data.
Requires RimScent, RimScent Extended and the Perfume Expansion.
